title: Carrie: The Musical offers $5 discount for Halloween weekend performances at The Carnegie
text:
Carrie: The Musical offers $5 discount for Halloween weekend performances at The Carnegie
Carrie: The Musical is offering a $5 discount for Halloween weekend performances at The Carnegie. The production runs through November 1 and features a cast from the University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music. Flexible subscription packages are also available for the upcoming season.
Audiences can save $5 on tickets to Carrie: The Musical at The Carnegie during Halloween weekend performances on October 30 and 31. The production, a co-production of The Carnegie and the University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music, is on stage through Sunday, November 1. The discount applies to Friday and Saturday shows when using the code HALLOWEEKEND, with the offer ending at 7:30 p.m. on Saturday, October 31.
Carrie: The Musical is based on the novel by Stephen King and tells the story of Carrie White, a shy outsider bullied at school and tormented at home by her religious mother. The show features a rock score and explores themes of terror, power, and teenage rage. According to the League of Cincinnati Theatres, "CARRIE: THE MUSICAL at The Carnegie is a marvelous example of what talented performers and imaginative direction can accomplish with challenging source material. The production balances dark subject matter with surprising humor and compelling acting… This is one prom you won’t want to miss!"
Talkin' Broadway also commented on the cast and production, stating, "A cast consisting primarily of CCM students, along with a few older pros, are up to the task of this challenging material. They, along with some unique design, intriguing direction, and more make this a solid choice for audiences leading up to the end-of-the-month spooky festivities."
Flexible subscription packages are available for The Carnegie’s upcoming season, allowing patrons to save up to 15% on adult ticket prices by selecting multiple shows. The 2027 season includes productions scheduled from January through November, as well as Queen City Cabaret performances in December 2026 and May 2027.
All sales for Carrie: The Musical are final, and offers cannot be combined. Additional information about the show and upcoming events can be found on The Carnegie’s website.
